description: pfBlockerNG supported pfSense version matrix. Edit this file to add/drop a version; all CI/build workflows read it at runtime. See LIFECYCLE below.

lifecycle_policy.add: Add an entry when a new pfSense beta or GA lands (curated — a human edits this file). Set status='beta' until the release is GA.
lifecycle_policy.drop_ce: Drop the oldest CE entry only when the newest CE goes GA. The supported window is always (previous GA CE + current GA CE), transiently +1 during an active beta.
lifecycle_policy.plus: Plus entries are always ci=false (build-only: we track the version and build .pkg artifacts, but never run Plus in CI — licensing).
lifecycle_policy.ci_metadata_pr: Changes to this file should be made via a PR against ci-metadata (branch-protected) so there is a git audit trail (diff/blame/rollback) without touching main/devel.
lifecycle_policy.future_migration: If CI infrastructure grows, this file can move to a dedicated public pfBlockerNG-ci-infra repo (read via raw URL, no token) — a mechanical swap.
